newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso says CVRD sell-off to go forward.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso says CVRD sell-off to go forward.

text.p: Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso said Wednesday he had no intention of backtracking on the privatization of state mining giant, Companhia Vale do Rio Doce, a news agency reported.
The private Invest News agency said Cardoso said an issue that important should be discussed with Congress,but he denied he might barter the CVRD sale for support for re-election.
"If I took seriously the retreat you say I'm going to make, I would have already fallen into the abyss," he told reporters. "When it needs to, the government backtracks, but this is not the case."
